items.title: How much does an event's age affect whether a manager remembers to cite it, unprompted?
items.description: Drag how many months have passed since a piece of work happened. This models the recall-decay effect behind recency bias from L1: the more time between the work and review time, the less likely a manager is to bring it up without being specifically asked. At 10 months — roughly the gap between Sam's February fix and a year-end review — recall drops to about the level that produced Dan's thin original packet in L3.
items.compute: const recallProbability = Math.max(5, Math.round(100 * Math.exp(-0.15 * params.monthsSinceEvent))); return { recallProbability };

outputs.label: Chance a manager cites it unprompted
